name: PPCHalt

name: OSInit

name: RealMode
evidence: clrlwi r3,r3,2; mtsrr0; mfmsr; IR and DR cleared; mtsrr1; rfi: the only rfi into a real-mode routine (__OSInitMemoryProtection's BAT set-up)

name: OSAllocFromHeap
evidence: OSAlloc.o order: just before OSFreeToHeap (Dolphin's); heap * 12 into the heap array at -0x7518(r13), the size rounded up to 32 bytes plus a 32-byte header

name: SoundInit
evidence: the game's sound set-up (the disc's symbol table, slib.a, names it too): main's call after ARAMInit (800120B0); fills the sound driver's configuration at 805A2B94 and sends it command 0x20000 through CpCall_SndDriver (8022B104); CpInitSoundDriver (8022ED5C) takes the heap from the configuration's +0x10. A hook: the names of the disc's table are another build's, aligned, and this one must not depend on that
